english.title: Fail to take appropriate steps when supervising person failing to comply with parliamentary elections rule 57
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to take appropriate steps when you were an appropriate supervisor of a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who failed to comply with a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), imposed in pursuance of regulations under rule 57 of the parliamentary elections rules
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66B(1)(b) and (5) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
